relations.text: KeysightがSpirentの高速イーサネット・ネットワークセキュリティ・チャネルエミュレーション事業を、Viaviに売却した

source.label: Keysight Technologies 10-K
source.quote: of investments, partially offset by $399 million provided by the divestiture of Spirent’s high-speed ethernet, network security and channel emulation business lines to Viavi Solutions Inc. and $30 million provided by sale of investments.

relations.text: ViaviとKeysightの間に、2025年3月2日付の資産購入契約がある

relations.text: NVIDIAなどとの提携により、AI-RANの深層学習モデルを展示する
relations.text_en: Through its partnership with NVIDIA and others, will showcase a deep-learning model for AI-RAN

source.label: VIAVI — NVIDIA AI-RAN demonstrations, March 1, 2026
source.quote: Through our partnership with NVIDIA, as well as with the AI-RAN Alliance and GlobalLogic, we will showcase a deep-learning model that can accurately distinguish genuine user equipment access requests from phantom signals and maintain strict L1 timing.

relations.text: MWC 2026でパートナーのNVIDIAとの協業を紹介する
relations.text_en: Presents collaborations with its partner NVIDIA at MWC 2026

source.label: VIAVI — NVIDIA AI-RAN demonstrations, March 1, 2026
source.quote: Schedule a meeting with us at MWC 2026 to get a deep dive into these exciting collaborations with our partner NVIDIA, and many more.

relations.text: Wells Fargo Bank, National Associationが管理代理人を務めるクレジット契約(2021年12月30日付)を結んでいる
relations.text_en: Entered into a credit agreement dated December 30, 2021 with Wells Fargo Bank, National Association as administrative agent

source.label: Viavi Solutions 10-K
source.quote: On December 30, 2021, we entered into a credit agreement (the Credit Agreement) with Wells Fargo Bank, National Association (Wells Fargo) as administrative agent and other lender-related parties.
source.note: 資金調達のみの関係です。

relations.text: 2025年10月16日、Spirent事業の取得完了と同時に、6億ドルのシニア担保付タームローン契約を結んだ
relations.text_en: On October 16, 2025, concurrent with closing of the Spirent HSE and CE acquisition, entered into a $600.0 million senior secured term loan credit agreement

source.label: Viavi Solutions 10-K
source.quote: On October 16, 2025, concurrent with the closing of the acquisition of Spirent’s HSE and CE business, the Company entered into a $ 600.0 million senior secured term loan credit agreement (Term Loan Credit Agreement) with Wells Fargo Bank, National Association (Wells Fargo), as administrative agent, and other lenders.

relations.text: JDS UniphaseとLumentum Holdingsの間に、2015年7月31日付の税務事項契約があり、年次報告の添付書類に挙がっている
relations.text_en: A Tax Matters Agreement dated as of July 31, 2015 between JDS Uniphase Corporation and Lumentum Holdings Inc. is listed in the annual report

source.label: Viavi Solutions 10-K
source.quote: Tax Matters Agreement, dated as of July 31, 2015, by and between JDS Uniphase Corporation and Lumentum Holdings Inc.
source.note: 分離に伴う過去の契約です。

relations.text: ヴィアヴィ・ソリューションズの年次報告が、競合として挙げている
relations.text_en: Named as a competitor in Viavi’s annual report

source.label: Viavi Solutions 10-K
source.quote: OSP competitors include providers of anti-counterfeiting technologies such as Giesecke & Devrient and Crane NXT; special-effect pigments such as GNMI Group and FYOTEC; optical coatings companies such as Materion, Zhejiang Crystal-Optech Co Ltd. and Platinum Optics Technology, Inc.; and manufacturers of passive and other optical components such as Coherent.

note.ja: 公式資料で確認できた関係だけを載せています。投資判断を勧めるものではありません。
